changelog: 5.9.31 (Build 5931): BUG FIX - tapping Yes on an update now actually switches RubyOS to the new version. Before, the new version's code clashed with the old version still in memory, so after tapping Yes you were still on the old version - and a few seconds later RubyOS asked you to update to the same version again. Now the update restarts RubyOS cleanly into the new version, so you see the 'Update complete' message and the new version straight away, and it no longer asks again for a version you already have.

5.9.31: BUG FIX - after an update, every time RubyOS started it threw 8 errors in the background (the old version's code ran again next to the new version's, and the old version number stayed in place). Booting a saved update is now clean: the old code is stopped before it can run twice, so the version shown everywhere is the new one.

Everything else is unchanged: fast update checking (about 3 seconds), the red roadblock screen with automatic fallback, the Google Drive update button, and Ruby AI stays off until its API key is ready.
